prompt: UTG holds AsKd on Kh-8d-3c-2s in position after BB checks. Hero has a medium range edge, but the board is not enough for clean pressure. Choose the best action.
why_v1: Call realizes the medium range edge in position while keeping the pot controlled.
feedback_correct_v1: Correct. Calling fits because position and a medium range edge support controlled realization more than a bigger pot.
feedback_incorrect_v1: Incorrect. Raising overstates the range edge, while folding gives up too much position; this spot should stay controlled with a call.
